1.1 Our mission

To give students and working professionals a safe, comfortable and affordable home in BTM Layout, with everything they need already in place.

Draft wording built on their posters. Confirm with the Brindavan team.

Our vision

To be the coliving space residents recommend to their friends: room to live, space to breathe.

1.2 Who we are

Room to live. Space to breathe.

Brindavan Coliving is a PG and coliving space at 7th Main, 2nd Stage BTM Layout, Bengaluru. Fully furnished 2-sharing rooms, a rooftop sit-out, a study area and daily housekeeping: a safe, comfortable and affordable living experience with all modern amenities.

1.4 Our promise

Comfortable.

02

2.1 Primary logo

Anatomy of the logo

  1. 1 House outline — home, drawn in one clean navy line with a wide doorstep
  2. 2 Leaves — navy leaves of a growing tree — residents settling in
  3. 3 Brown trunk — warm wood, the same brown as COLIVING
  4. 4 BRINDAVAN — a classic bold serif with a taller B, in Brindavan Navy
  5. 5 COLIVING — wide-spaced capitals between two brown rules
12345

Always use the supplied file. Never redraw, recolour or rearrange it.

2.2 Logo system

One logo, four versions

Rebuilt from the poster logo: the emblem is traced, the name set in Trirong Bold and Montserrat SemiBold. The horizontal, badge and reversed versions are new — approve them before use.

1  Primary (stacked)

The default. Posters, signboard, welcome sheet.

2  Horizontal

Wide, short spaces. Website header, signboard, letterhead.

3  Emblem

When the name is already nearby. Watermarks, door plates.

4  Badge

Profile picture, WhatsApp, reel corners, favicon.

2.3 Clear space and size

Give it room to breathe

Clear space on every side equals x, the height of the “C” in COLIVING. On photos, put the logo on a white panel, as the posters already do.

xxxx

Primary

120 px · 30 mm

Horizontal

170 px · 40 mm

Badge

48 px · 12 mm

2.4 Logo on colour

Navy on light, white panel on colour

On white, Ivory or Blush, use the logo as it is. On photos, terracotta or tan, put it on a white panel. On navy, use the reversed version.

3.5 Colour rules

The 60–30–10 rule

60% light — Paper, Ivory or Blush, so room photos glow.

30% Brindavan Navy — headlines, amenity bands, signs.

10% warm accent — terracotta or brown for the one thing to notice.

Section 06

Voice

  • 6.1Brand personality
  • 6.2Tone in practice

06

6.1 Brand personality

A friendly host who keeps the place spotless

Warm, practical and reassuring. Talks to students and young professionals like a good senior would.

Welcoming

Do: Speak to new residents like guests arriving home.

Not: Cold “rules and fines” first.

Practical

Do: Name the real amenities: WiFi, washing, parking, housekeeping.

Not: Vague “all facilities available”.

Reassuring

Do: Talk about safety and cleanliness plainly.

Not: Fear-based “unsafe PGs everywhere” claims.

Light

Do: Short, upbeat lines that fit a reel.

Not: Long paragraphs on posters.

6.2 Tone in practice

How we write

Headline, then one line on why, then amenities, then contact and address.

English with a little Kannada or Hindi in reels is fine. One or two emoji per caption at most: 🏠 ✨

Always Brindavan Coliving — not “Brundhavana PG” or “Brindhavan PG”. The posters currently mix spellings.

Write this

Room to live. Space to breathe.

Come for the location. Stay for the comfort.

Only 15 slots left this month. Book a room visit.

Not this

CHEAPEST PG IN BTM!!! HURRY!!!

All facilities available. DM for details.

Brundhavana PG has you covered.
